title: Tennis: Alex Eala advances to Hong Kong Open final, outlasts Sakkari
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala is headed to the final of the 2026 Hong Kong Tennis Open after outlasting Greece's Maria Sakkari in a stop-and-start affair that featured several weather delays.
